criteria.criterion: OUTCOME CHANNEL. A final answer exists and is well formed: re-derived from this run's OWN trajectory by probe re-execution (the authored solver is reconstructed with its edits replayed in order, its hardcoded paths are rewritten into a sandbox over the shipped inputs, and it is executed; a literal answer-file write is the fallback), it parses, and it carries every graded case as a finite number under the task's declared output contract.

OUTCOME CHANNEL, GATE. Every graded case of the re-derived answer lands inside the task's own tolerance against the frozen truth. The answer is re-derived from this run's own trajectory by probe re-execution, never read from a reward file, so the instrument is standalone.
Read the baked record under /root/data (observations.csv and receivers.csv).
Authored a hand-written solver rather than assembling the answer by hand.
Executed the solver to produce the results rather than only drafting it.
Formed the difference of the two frequencies' code pseudoranges at each epoch.
Keyed the instrumental lookup on the ordered signal pair named in receivers.csv for that receiver, which is not the same at every receiver.
Resolved a space-vehicle entry and a station entry and summed them into one total per arc.
Subtracted the total instrumental term from the geometry-free observable rather than adding it.
Branched on whether the product publishes the wanted ordered pair before assembling it from other rows: the direct row first, the reversed row negated, a chain only as the fallback.
Reduced each epoch from slant to vertical using that epoch's elevation angle, then averaged the arc.
Emitted /root/results.json under the arc_mean_vtec_tecu contract.

The geometry-free observable was converted to slant content with the frequency-dependent factor the task statement pins - written out, loaded from the shipped record, or bound to a named constant. Any algebraically equivalent arrangement of the same factor counts. The graded increment is the FACTOR: naming the quantity is corroboration, never the evidence.

GUARDRAIL, DEGREE-OF-ERROR: no instrumental term of ANY kind ever enters the computation - the geometry-free observable is reduced and averaged uncalibrated. This grades the SEVEREST degree of the calibration error only. It is deliberately NOT the negation of R8, which fails whenever the satellite-side and station-side entries are not BOTH resolved and summed - including the far commoner one-sided route. Any instrumental vocabulary at all silences this guardrail.
GUARDRAIL: the uncorrected orientation figure from question.json is copied through as the answer.
GUARDRAIL: read or probed the grading surface - /verifier, /oracle, expected_values.json, golden.json, truth.md, rubric.yaml or build/.
GUARDRAIL: attempted to fetch the bias product, the format specification or any other external resource.
The reasoning distinguishes the arcs whose ordered pair is published directly from those whose pair has to be assembled from other rows, rather than treating every arc as the same lookup.

The reasoning checks the calibrated result against a physical expectation - vertical content positive and of order tens of TECU, a nanosecond of uncorrected delay worth several TECU - rather than reporting whatever came out.
The agent states which instrumental values it applied and where they came from.
